# Welcome to the Moderation Arena

Social media platforms each have their own content policy, so the **same post** can be allowed on one platform and
restricted on another. In this demo, an AI model was asked to moderate real posts under the policies of different
platforms. Your job is to look at the post and judge **which platform's decision you find better**.

## What you will see

For every round you get:

* **One post** from Bluesky, TikTok or X — text, and sometimes images, a video and its audio transcript.
  If the text or transcript is not in English, a *Translate to English* link appears under it and opens Google Translate in a new tab.
* **Two decisions** by the same model, from two different platform policies (**Policy A** and **Policy B**).
  Each decision has a **label** (what kind of content the policy considers the post to be, or *No moderation*)
  and an **action** (what the platform would do, or *No action*). Both are shown in one uniform vocabulary taken
  from the EU Digital Services Act (DSA), so the two policies can be compared directly: labels are DSA content
  categories (for example *Violence*, *Cyber violence*, *Illegal or harmful speech*), and actions are DSA restriction
  types (*Removed*, *Demoted*, *Age Restricted*, *Labeled*, *Account Restriction*, plus *Send Resources*). Each name has a fixed colour.

The platform names are hidden while you vote, and which policy is on the left is random.

## How to vote

1. Read the post. Open the media or the transcript if there is any.
2. Compare the two **labels**. Mark which policy's label fits the post better: **A**, **B**, **Both** (equally good) or **Neither** (neither is good).
3. Do the same for the two **actions**.
4. Press **Submit vote**.

After you vote, the two platforms are revealed, together with the **policy quotes** each decision relied on, the
model's **explanation** and the full text of each policy (**Show full policy**). These are hidden before the vote so they do not influence your choice.

Then press **Next post** to continue. If you are unsure about a post or would rather not judge it, press **Skip**.

## Good to know

* **Content warning.** The posts are sampled from real platform data and may contain graphic, sexual, violent or hateful content.
  You can skip any post, and stop at any time.
* **You are anonymous.** There are no accounts. The name you chose at the start (a made-up one) is only used to keep your votes together; we collect no other personal information.
* **There are no right or wrong answers** — we are interested in your own judgement. After you vote you can read each policy in full with **Show full policy**.
* The **Leaderboard** in the sidebar shows how the policies rank based on everyone's votes (**Overall**) or only yours (**Mine**). This is a demo version, so the numbers are early and will change as more votes arrive.

* **Data.** We store only your made-up name, your preferences and the post they refer to. If a post is not in English, the beginning of its text may be sent to Google from your browser to detect the language.

**Ready?** Press the button below to get a random post.
